# Muhammad Suleman Saleem

> Full-Stack Software Engineer & AI Product Engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Builds production AI/LLM systems (RAG, multi-provider orchestration, MCP), Flutter mobile apps, and n8n automation pipelines. Currently Full-Stack Software Engineer & AI Product Engineer / Team Lead at Techtiz. Bachelor of Computer Science, Information Technology University (ITU), Lahore.

## AI & LLM Products

- [NebuFit](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/nebufit/): AI-powered fitness coaching platform — RAG-processed bloodwork, computer-vision body analysis, multi-LLM (Claude, GPT-4o, ElevenLabs) voice coaching with SSE streaming and automatic failover, Flutter + Nest.js, Stripe subscriptions.
- [Creative OS](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/creative-os/): Local-first AI assistant for creators, built on an MCP server architecture so it can search and reason over a user's own local files (screenplays, lyrics, notes) without third-party upload.

## Enterprise & Desktop Platforms

- [Orient Champions](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/orient-champions/): Nationwide field-sales incentive platform for Orient Electronic — React Native + Nest.js, real-time SAP ERP sync across a four-level hierarchy. Refactor eliminated ~90% of previously reported bugs.
- [UNITY Desktop App & Admin Portal](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/unity-desktop-admin-portal/): Desktop app and admin portal for a healthcare organisation — role-built navigation and live admin configuration.

## Mobile Applications

- [Houzi](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/houzi/): Flutter real estate app for the Houzez WordPress ecosystem. 53,000+ theme owners, 4.84★ rating, 500+ CodeCanyon sales, 5,000+ Play Store downloads. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/houzi-app-for-houzez/id1598357211) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.booleanbites.houzez&hl=en) · [CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/item/houzi-real-estate-app/39753350)
- [Linked Golf](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/linked-golf/): Flutter golf social and booking app — availability matching, QR buddy adds, PubNub chat, Stripe-billed event subscriptions. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/linked-golf/id1619093321) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.linkedgolfapp.mobile&hl=en)
- [Exodus App](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/exodus-app/): Healthcare app for doctors and patients (appointments, medications, lab results, wearable-synced vitals), rebranded from Blue Sky to Exodus. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.blueskypro.mobile)

- [Ramirez Legal Group — ClickUp Dashboard Sync](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/ramirez-legal-clickup-sync/): Real-time case data sync into ClickUp.
- [Social Media Posting Automation](https://muhammadsulemansaleem.github.io/work/social-media-posting-automation/): Auto-posts to 6 platforms (YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, TikTok) with zero silent failures.
